name: Collage and photo cut-out (Gilliam / newsprint)
look: scissored photos with white edges, torn newsprint, tape, handwritten arrows, jerky puppet motion.

fits.notes: culture, media, community, music, social products; AI-image-powered ("photo of anything") products

type.guidance: mixed ransom-note type, Times + grotesk, highlighter yellow, red, black on newsprint.
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text.

colour.guidance: mixed ransom-note type, Times + grotesk, highlighter yellow, red, black on newsprint.
colour.rule: Style palette fills the world; the brand colour takes the role named in brand_lock.colour_role and never drops below the contrast of the brand's own palette.

keeps: real product UI capture (composited as a screen plate, never redrawn)
brand_lock.colour_role: brand colour is the highlighter or the flat colour field
brand_lock.type_role: mixed ransom-note type for scraps, brand face for the one clean claim
brand_lock.world_changes: scissored photos, tape and stamps on a poster that assembles
brand_lock.rule: Under a brand lock the brand colour, type and logo stay; the style world (material, picture language, motion grammar, finish, sound) is what varies between looks. A branded launch shows 3 different style worlds.

motion_grammar.note: grammars lists existing library/grammars ids; grammars_planned lists world grammars the engine plan adds (game-world, tabletop, os-desktop, type-only, editorial, collage, cinematic-world).

effects_note: rasan-fx passes (runtime/rasan-fx.js); order is the pass order. {brand_colour} / {second_ink} are filled from the brand or look palette.

codex_assets.prompt_template: cut-out {subject} photo with white outline, scissored edge, on flat colour, consistent lighting, plus newsprint texture and torn-edge mask
codex_assets.r1_note: cut-out subjects with white outlines on flat colour, newsprint textures, torn-edge masks; A1 + A2.
codex_assets.rules: Flat, evenly lit plain background (chroma green or pure white) for clean cut-outs; one prompt family with the same seed words; generate at 2x and downscale; never ask Codex for readable UI text or logos (typeset them in HTML).

build.engine_meaning: reference only (builder hand-codes it) / buildable today
build.recipe: `library/styles/collage.md`, `paperclip.md`, `motion/collage/cutout-collage-gilliam.md`, `medium-paper.js`; `art.mjs treat` halftone. SVG filter edges (feMorphology white outline), CSS `mix-blend-mode: multiply`.

product_ui_rule: If the film shows RasanAI Studio, use the current dark sidebar UI with the Describe...Final dot stepper (docs/brand/studio-ui/), as a real capture composited INTO this style; never the retired light UI.

palettes.name: Newsprint red
palettes.words: aged newsprint, black ink, signal red, highlighter yellow

palettes.name: Photocopy
palettes.words: photocopy grey-white, toner black, hot orange-red, ballpoint blue

palettes.name: Zine pink
palettes.words: pale pink stock, black, hot pink, teal

brand_lock.rule: Brand colour is the highlighter/accent cut (one tape strip, one circled word); paper tone and black stay style-fixed. Slots marked brand take the brand colour (exact hex); slots marked style keep the palette value; brand-or-style takes the brand colour only when its contrast against the other slot is at least 4.5:1, else the palette value.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

pairings.note: Ransom-note mix: set each word in a different cut (serif, grotesk, mono) on tape-coloured chips.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

type.load: In a HyperFrames composition add the two <link> tags from `google` to <head> (plus rel=preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), set font-family from `css`, and wait for document.fonts.ready before the first screenshot / timeline build. Offline renders: download the families once (they are OFL) into the project's fonts/ folder and use @font-face. The brand face always sets the real claim line and the product UI text; the style pairing is for the world's chrome and display.
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text. Under a brand lock keep the brand face for the claim and use the pairing's display for labels only.

finish.how: Runtime: RasanFX.create({ source, passes: [...] }) from runtime/rasan-fx.js, applied in the listed order, on the whole composition canvas or on the Codex plate only (plate-only when the type must stay crisp). `css` lists the cheap approximation kinds story boards and style frames draw with plain CSS (grain:<opacity>, scan:<opacity>, halftone, pixel, led-dots ...).

composition.grid: rough 3-col pasteboard; cut-outs rotated -6 to +6 degrees, overlapped
composition.safe_area: 6% margin, torn edges may bleed off the frame
composition.fill: dense: fills 80-90% but one cut-out holds the hero
composition.product_ui: UI is cut out as a printed screenshot with tape corners; the capture stays unaltered

codex.template: {subject} {action}, {setting}. Camera and lens: flat top-down scan of a pasteboard, even light, slight lens-cap vignette. Lighting: flat scanner light with soft shadows under each torn paper edge and tape. Material: newsprint, photocopied black-and-white photos, torn edges, masking tape, marker circles. Colour, locked to the palette {palette_words}, and nothing outside it. Texture and finish: coarse halftone dots, photocopy toner speckle, creases, tape translucency. Avoid: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no clean vector shapes, no gradients, no colour photographs (photocopy them), no perfect alignment, no 3D render.
codex.camera: flat top-down scan of a pasteboard, even light, slight lens-cap vignette
codex.lighting: flat scanner light with soft shadows under each torn paper edge and tape
codex.material: newsprint, photocopied black-and-white photos, torn edges, masking tape, marker circles
codex.colour_rule: Name the palette's colours in words (the palette's `words`), never hex codes; add 'and nothing outside this palette'. Pick one palette per film and keep it.
codex.texture: coarse halftone dots, photocopy toner speckle, creases, tape translucency

aspect.note: Plates: ask for about 12% bleed around the frame so the camera can travel; keep the calm side empty for type. Generate 16:9 for the frame, 1:1 for sprite sheets and objects.

consistency.anchor: Make the anchor plate first, approve it by eye, then pass it as --ref to every other image (imagegen batch does this with --world).
consistency.style_line: Append the world bible's style line (30-45 words, no hex) to every prompt.
consistency.seed_words: Keep these words verbatim in every prompt of the film: newsprint; flat top-down scan of a pasteboard; aged newsprint, black ink, signal red, highlighter yellow.

sprite_sheet.rules: Not a sprite style. For a cut-out object or character use --transparent (flat #00FF00 key, then despill); one subject, no shadow plane.
